RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the July 26, 2002 / Sravana  4, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean
Development; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel;
Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions—155
WIN2\SESSION\2181RS 230
Sugarcane-based cropping system
1029. SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
implement a Centrally sponsored scheme
on sustainable development of sugarcane-
based cropping system;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the funds earmarked under the
scheme;
(d) the States where the scheme is
proposed to be implemented; and
(e) the details of steps taken in this
regard?
Water crisis due to drought
†1030. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
various long term and short term measures
in order to deal with the water crisis arising
out of drought situation in certain States
due to scanty rainfall;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the extent to which the water crisis is
likely to be solved as a result of short term
measures; and
(d) the States which have been benefited
thereby?
Development of rice strains
1031. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether super rice strains would be
coming this monsoon which would double
or treble the present yield; and
(b) if so, the details regarding
development of such a variety of rice strains?
Jute production
1032. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the quantity of jute production in
the country during the last three years,
State-wise;

(b) the quantity of procurement by JCI
during the same period, State-wise;
(c) the minimum support price during
the corresponding years and the actual prices
prevailing during these periods;
(d) whether Government are aware that
West Bengal farmers started growing jute at
the instance of the Central Government, to
save the jute industry; and
(e) whether Government are also aware
of complete dismantling of the mandatory
Jute (Packaging) Order and the reaction of
jute growers thereon?
Banned medicines in U.P. dairies
1033. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that dairy owners
of Uttar Pradesh are using banned medicines
for faster milking;
(b) if so, the action taken by Government
to curb such practices; and
(c) what are the reports from other
States?
Targets of cooperative movement
1034. SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have achieved
the targets fixed for the cooperative
movement;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, whether Government have
identified the obstacles in achieving the
targets of this movement; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken to remove
such obstacles?
Agricultural proposals of Karnataka
Government
1035. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the projects and proposals of
Karnataka Government pending for
approval/sanction in the Ministry of
Agriculture; and
(b) what action has been taken to clear
these projects/proposals?
NATP and CGP network projects in
States
1036. DR. ARUN KUMAR SARMA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of various national and
regional NATP and CGP network projects
implemented in each phase upto Phase III,
indicating the locations, allocations and
implementation status;
(b) the State-wise list of projects under
NATP submitted to ICAR and the details of
those sanctioned during NATP I, II, III in
the NER for Animal Husbandary, Fishery,
Agriculture and PHT sector, with separate
indication of total allocation and
implementation status; and
(c) the details of ICAR ad-hoc research
projects submitted from the NER,
institution-wise, the details of projects
approved, indicating the total allocation and
sector-wise implementation status in
Agriculture, Animal Husbandary and PHT,
during the last three years?

Misappropriation of funds at KVKs
1037. SHRI KAILASH JOSHI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of complaints regarding
corruption and misappropriation of funds
in Krishi Vigyan Kendras especially at
Sironi, Distt. Vidisha (MP);
(b) the details of NGOs running such
Kendras;
(c) whether any inquiry committee was
set up in respect of Kendra mentioned in
part (a) above; if so, when the report was
submitted and the findings thereof; and
(d) since how long the action is pending
before Government and whether any
responsibility has been fixed for delaying
the action; if so, the details thereof?
